title: Everspin leads JEDEC task group for MRAM-LPDDR standard
summary: JEDEC SmartBrief highlights Everspin’s work leading a JEDEC task group exploring how MRAM could be integrated into the LPDDR ecosystem. The initiative is looking at support for persistent memory in LPDDR5 and LPDDR6 controller architectures, with the goal of making MRAM easier to adopt in systems that need low-power, non-volatile memory.The SmartBrief coverage points readers to the recent EE Times article examining the task group and Everspin’s efforts to broaden MRAM adoption through an industry standard.
body_markdown:
JEDEC SmartBrief highlights Everspin’s work leading a JEDEC task group exploring how MRAM could be integrated into the LPDDR ecosystem. The initiative is looking at support for persistent memory in LPDDR5 and LPDDR6 controller architectures, with the goal of making MRAM easier to adopt in systems that need low-power, non-volatile memory.


The SmartBrief coverage points readers to the recent EE Times article examining the task group and Everspin’s efforts to broaden MRAM adoption through an industry standard.
